description:
Row Row Row Your Boat Rhymes 1st Std! — Row row row your boat gently down the stream! Why does a tiny pebble sink instantly, but a massive wooden boat floats?
Kids science answer for "row row row your boat rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

A tiny pebble sinks because it is solid and heavy for its size, but a hollow boat pushes aside water that pushes back upward with equal lifting power called buoyancy.
